_comment: House-style bake-off (2026-11-09): five candidate styles, written in our own words (no named artists), × the five SDXL checkpoints × (no LoRA + Retro_Illustration + Animated_Concept; Pixel_Xl_V1 only for the HD-pixel style) × ten Game I pictures (8 scenes at 16:9, 2 portraits). Same seed and sampler as sdxl_v1. Categories are the styles (s1..s5, with a _portrait twin); by_category/<style>/<picture>/ puts every model's take on one picture in one style side by side. William's direction: high resolution, vivid, beautiful where appropriate, horrific where appropriate, good composition. The non-SDXL checkpoints (Krea 2, MOSS-Image) need their own graphs and are not in this suite — docs/NEXT_MODELS.md.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated neon, plastic skin, extra heads, duplicated figures
